notes.title: 1.29.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Introducing Rabbit Raffles - A new way to earn free skins! Enter the weekly raffle by merging rabbits. 1 merge = 1 ticket.

New & Improved:
[list]
[*] New Item: Cactus Crate - A spikey crate that will damage anything that touches it.
[*] New Item: A beautiful cherry blossom tree.
[*] New builder item variants! Available in wood, stone, metal, and gold! Piston, Rabbit Statue, Cross Statue, Gargoyle Statue, Trophy Statue, Buddha Statue, Cactus, Rosebush, Flowerbush, Carrot, Sunflower, Fountains, Bonsai, Rotating Saw, Locked Crate, Lever, Windmill, Crystals, Element Pits, Cactus Crate, Windmill, Flag.
[*] Press space to toggle zoom in builder
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Poison not working on ice-type enemies
[*] Burning skeleton fire was too small
[*] Z-order of element pits
[*] Color of pressed pressure plate now matches active spikes
[/list]

notes.title: 1.28.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
We've added some new items to make building levels even more fun!

Elemental Snowmen and Skeletons are immune to elements based on their type. We've also added speed settings to all enemies so you can decide how fast or slow they move.

Elemental mushrooms can freeze, burn, poison, or charm whatever destroys them. These are a great way to create one-off elemental effects in your levels.

Engines now have material variants for even more possibilities.

Happy Hopping!

notes.title: Golden Builder Update
notes.notes:
This is our largest content update in a while! We've filled out the game with Wood, Stone, Metal, and the brand new Gold material variants for Pressure Plates, Spikes, Crates, Levers, and more! Find the new items in the Builder Upgrades menu in your levels page.

You'll also notice Goats and Snowmen have had their art improved, we hope you like the new look!

We've also fixed a few bugs:
[list]
[*] Linked platforms getting separated sometimes
[*] Crown power not taking effect before first move
[*] Skeletons hopping gaps between land sometimes
[/list]
Happy Hopping!

notes.title: New grounds, carpet, polish, bug fixes #23
notes.notes:
Lots of cleanup in this update. Improved the appearance of the forest ground tileset and fixed many bugs. 

We hope you’re enjoying the endless creativity King Rabbit has to offer. 
With several hundred new levels being published daily, you’ll never run out of levels to play. 
Don’t forget to follow builders you like, and give them tips. :)

[b]Changes[/b]

- Improved ground art
- Added carpet item for 100 gems
- Improved start up time
- Improved loading time on play page and realm page
- Bombs are no longer affected by poison
- Fixed artifacts showing on ice ground
- Fixed pistons appearing as opened when closed sometimes
- Fixed exiting hole with an extended piston on top
- Fixed crate in river not moving after freeing it from a blockage
- Fixed some strange ground collisions
- Fixed saw getting pushed out of movement path sometimes
- Fixed requests getting stuck sometimes
- Fixed river appearing through potion ground

Many more great updates are on the way. 
We hope you consider subscribing or purchase a limited-edition rabbit to support continued development. <3

Cheers,
Brian & Austin

notes.title: Kingdom and Realms update! #16
notes.notes:
To make the campaign more engaging, we’ve created the “Kingdom” and “Realms” that you can explore. We hope you enjoy this new campaign structure! :)

[b]KINGDOM[/b]

The kingdom is the central location or “home” that ties the game together. Within the Kingdom there are different realms that you can access.

[b]REALMS[/b]

Each realm contains three portals. Each portal contains 10 levels, the last level has a portal gem. To complete the realm, you must find the portal gem! For the completionist types, if you find all of the gold in a portal - there will be a gold border surrounding the portal gem. 

Currently we offer two realms; [b]Garden[/b] and [b]Community[/b]. Over time we will continue to add new realms for you to explore.

[b]NEW LEVEL FILTERS[/b]

Portals for "best", "puzzle", and "Action" can now be found in the community realm. Best levels are determined by community feedback and an algorithm.

[b]EXPANSIONS REFUNDED[/b]

Previously, we were selling packs of the “best” levels for gems under the name "pink diamond expansion". Anyone who purchased the expansion has been refunded. We will no longer be selling packs, but instead giving away for free! 

Let us know what you think in the comments! <3

[b]OTHER STUFF[/b]

* Snowmen charge 2 tiles now
* Art updated for several items
* Ice crown now allows rabbit to walk on ice without slipping
* Fire and element pit particles updated
* Items float higher making them easier to see behind walls
* Themed walls are back
